method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: top-fraction Augmented Hill-Climb updates against a frozen prior policy
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: ancestral token sampling from an online reward-conditioned molecular policy

For each assigned preparation seed, compare the epoch-eight token_nll with the epoch-five token_nll from the same unchanged clean-training trajectory, then report the three paired differences and their arithmetic mean. applicability_conditions: The fixed 250000-example unlabeled reservoir and Parent GRU must remain optimization-stable for three additional clean teacher-forcing passes at the inherited learning rate.

The mechanism is most applicable when the five-epoch Parent is still underfit, as indicated by token NLL continuing to fall through its terminal epoch, rather than when further likelihood fitting has already plateaued.

Lower clean-token NLL is an intermediate prior-fitting result, not proof of better reward-reachable support; extra passes can instead overconcentrate common corpus chemistry or reduce access to rare useful modes.

Nodes n-b992903add3b and n-7a4ed835db7f show that broad unique-valid or online-support gains alone did not improve the three-seed score, so benchmark utility remains a separate required comparison even if token NLL decreases.

Preparation remains strictly label-free and task agnostic, and transfer requires the unchanged two-file artifact schema, vocabulary indices, special-token meanings, architecture, and downstream policy interfaces to load successfully.

The claim is scoped to the supplied corpus reservoir procedure, inherited fixed-rate optimizer and regularization, Parent GRU, eight total epochs, and assigned three-seed panel; other corpora, model capacities, or schedules require a new comparison.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if any preparation trains for a count other than eight epochs or if corpus selection, tokenization, model capacity, optimizer, learning rate, regularization, artifact interface, or run-mode behavior differs from the Parent. research_intent.implementation_change: Change only the Parent's corpus-prior training duration from five to eight epochs. The existing per-epoch diagnostics and training_epochs configuration field record the intervention and its token-NLL observable.
research_intent.mechanism: Continue the Parent's otherwise unchanged clean corpus-prior teacher-forcing schedule for three additional passes, increasing total pretraining from five to eight epochs so the autoregressive GRU can further reduce unresolved corpus next-token uncertainty before its weights are frozen.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-6174d6127af5 stops clean corpus pretraining after five epochs even though its seed-0 token NLL falls monotonically from 1.0043740272521973 at epoch one to 0.6764117479324341 at epoch five, with the final step still improving from 0.693612277507782. Node n-b992903add3b reproduces terminal epoch-five NLL values of 0.6764117479324341, 0.6806491017341614, and 0.676954984664917 across the three preparations, so the limiting active-layer behavior is a fixed early stop without evidence that clean next-token fitting has plateaued. Other active-layer attempts do not settle this mechanism: n-b992903add3b selected checkpoints for broad ancestral support but reduced macro score by 0.008551034406275007, n-7a4ed835db7f expanded corpus coverage and raised the weakest online support while reducing macro score by 0.02463049649027767, and n-2661e5071749's noisy-prefix training was refuted. The distinct test here is additional optimization on exactly the Parent's clean reservoir and objective, not another support selector, corpus expansion, or denoising input.

applicability_conditions: Confirmed activation applies to the supplied seed-dependent 250000-example unlabeled reservoirs, corpus-derived vocabularies, clean teacher-forcing objective, inherited two-layer GRU, AdamW learning rate and regularization, deterministic epoch ordering, and eight-total-epoch schedule for preparation seeds 0 through 2.

The observed Parent was still improving at its terminal epoch and remained optimization-stable for three further passes. On every seed, epoch-five NLL is below epoch four and each of epochs six, seven, and eight is below the preceding epoch, so the continuation mechanism is supported under the intended underfit/non-plateau condition.

Preparation remains label-free and task agnostic in the observed implementation. Within each seed the Candidate configuration is identical to the Parent configuration except for training_epochs=8 rather than 5, and all three artifacts publish and load the frozen smiles_prior.pt plus smiles_policy.json schema with unchanged vocabulary indices, special-token meanings, dimensions, and maximum length.

The evidence supports reduced clean training-trajectory token NLL, not improved chemical diversity or objective utility. The lower static unique-valid rate, mixed online support, and slightly lower three-seed benchmark mean show that continuation should not be treated as beneficial merely because the likelihood observable activated.

Transfer is not established beyond this corpus reservoir procedure, model capacity, optimizer, regularization, fixed learning rate, eight-epoch stopping point, task suite, or three-seed panel. A schedule beyond eight epochs or a setting whose five-epoch model has plateaued requires a new evaluation.

possible_failure_causes: The additional likelihood fitting reduced broad preparation-time support on the inherited 256-draw checks. The mean rate therefore falls from 0.83984375 to 0.79296875, a paired mean change of -0.046875, while completion remains high but falls from 766/768 to 764/768. This is consistent with extra clean passes concentrating probability on common corpus continuations at the expense of diverse valid samples, although these artifacts do not isolate that explanation causally.

Lower token NLL did not produce the preregistered benchmark-score increase. Candidate seed val_scores are 0.49743649856375, 0.511535359669411, and 0.52562649945345 versus paired Parent values 0.544472616912355, 0.498752613558053, and 0.499594775007781. Their arithmetic means are 0.511532785895537 and 0.5142733351593963, a paired mean change of -0.00274054926385936 rather than the required increase. Effects are seed- and task-heterogeneous: the Candidate loses 0.04703611834860505 on seed 0 but gains on seeds 1 and 2, and its three-seed deco_hop mean falls by 0.07107158819705572 while the other four task means increase. The evaluations show that likelihood improvement is not sufficient for reward-reachable support but do not identify which probability shifts caused the mixed task effects.

Online complete-conditioned novel-valid support is also mixed rather than uniformly improved. Candidate seed yields are 0.8426917667423997, 0.8047163660073897, and 0.8227019954203467 versus Parent values 0.8396073778448927, 0.7832720190434971, and 0.8541171385346877. The first two seeds increase but seed 2 decreases by 0.031415143114341015, and the arithmetic mean changes from 0.8256655118076925 to 0.8233700427233787. Because these measurements include downstream reward-conditioned adaptation, they indicate an absence of robust support benefit rather than isolating the frozen eight-epoch prior's causal contribution.

The token_nll diagnostic is accumulated over the training minibatches themselves, not over a disjoint held-out corpus panel. Its consistent decrease proves continued optimization of the registered clean objective, but the replicas cannot distinguish better transferable next-token generalization from increasing fit or confidence on the fixed reservoir.

Only one supplied corpus procedure, one 250000-example reservoir size, one GRU capacity, the inherited fixed-rate optimizer and regularization, exactly eight epochs, and preparation seeds 0 through 2 were tested. Longer schedules could plateau or destabilize, and other corpora, vocabularies, architectures, or learning rates require a new paired trajectory rather than extrapolation from this result.
